description: Source file implementing the PropertyProvider class and GesturesProp class for managing gesture properties, including creation, retrieval, dumping, and setting properties, with support for IDC file loading and type-specific handling.

classes.name: PropertyProvider
classes.description: Manages gesture properties, including creation, access, dumping, and loading from IDC files.

classes.name: GesturesProp
classes.description: Represents individual gesture properties with support for different data types, dumping, and IDC property parsing.

methods.name: hasProperty
methods.description: Checks if a property with the given name exists.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string dump of all properties.

methods.name: loadPropertiesFromIdcFile
methods.description: Loads properties from an IDC configuration file, mapping keys to properties.
